instructions: Treat this as cinema: foreground mood and atmosphere, locate every scene in a specific place and time of day.

aspects.label: Mise en scène
aspects.prompt: Staging, blocking, composition; the spatial arrangement of figures and objects, depth and foreground/background relations, environment and props.

aspects.label: Costume design
aspects.prompt: Garments, fabrics, textures, colours and accessories; how dress signals status, era, mood or character.

aspects.label: Character behaviour
aspects.prompt: Recurring gestures, micro-behaviours, habits, tics and body language, and what they reveal about the character.
